description: A forest-green floor-length noble dress with a fitted opaque bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. A cream inset appears at the front bodice and through the long green skirt panels. Wide pale gold knotwork-like borders run along the bodice, sleeves, front skirt and hem. A dark patterned belt has a large round metal buckle and small round side ornaments. Two decorative round brooches fasten the upper bodice near the shoulders. A green patterned wrap hangs around the lower arms and down both sides. A small pendant necklace and brown shoes are visible. Exact textile fibres are uncertain.
